zh-CN: 演算珍珠的堆积位置按室内可活动区域定位，修复贴墙堆积和恢复零重力后不归位的问题。
撤销和重做绘画时保留当前部件、画布视角和面板滚动位置，包括切换部件后的第一笔。
选择绘画部件后，自动展开并定位左侧对应参数。
投影图片可直接替换并撤销替换，保留已有轨道和关键帧；整理素材操作与轨道参数布局。
支持从画布外起笔，笔划在图像边缘自然裁切；完全未碰到图像的操作不留下编辑记录。
en: Align work-pearl pile positions with the chamber’s usable interior and fix pearls collecting against walls or failing to return after zero gravity resumes.
Keep the selected part, canvas view and panel scroll positions when undoing or redoing paint, including the first stroke after switching parts.
Selecting a paint part automatically expands and scrolls to its corresponding settings on the left.
Replace projection images and undo replacements while preserving tracks and keyframes; tidy asset actions and track controls.
Start strokes outside the canvas and clip them at the image edges; gestures that never touch the image do not create edit history.

zh-CN: 修正演算环背后柔光被原版更新覆盖的问题，颜色、强度、范围和开关按当前项目保持同步。
统一房间渐变在没有色标时的网页预览与游戏颜色。
en: Keep the current project’s rear glow color, intensity, range and visibility synchronized after native light updates.
Match the room-gradient web preview to the game when no color stops are present.

zh-CN: 新建迭代器使用随模组提供的 Rained 等待房间，修正默认连接出口。
未编辑过的旧默认等待房间可在再次应用项目时升级；保留自行编辑的房间和外部房间连接。
en: New iterator projects use the bundled Rained waiting room with the correct connection exit.
Reapplying a project upgrades unchanged legacy waiting rooms while preserving custom rooms and external connections.

zh-CN: 首次发布：整合外观、对话与珍珠、广播、投影、区域连接编辑和独立模组导出。
新增游戏主菜单“更多迭代器”，集中查看演算室、广播和珍珠预览。
统一网页撤销与重做，整理表单、图层、悬停和可拖动分栏。
广播支持角色绑定颜色与 RainocTool 1.1.2 JSON 导入；实验语音支持剧情台词试听与自定义声线。
项目关联内容可预览后选择保留、删除或迁移，保护共享珍珠并保留恢复记录。
发布包从空作品库开始，包含中英文界面、更新记录、感谢名单和 Discord 反馈入口。
en: Initial release with appearance, dialogue and pearl text, broadcast, projection and region-connection editing, plus standalone mod export.
Added the More Iterators main-menu hub for chamber, broadcast and pearl previews.
Unified undo and redo, compact forms, texture layers, hover styles and resizable panels.
Added speaker-bound broadcast colors and RainocTool 1.1.2 JSON import, plus experimental dialogue-based voice previews and custom presets.
Related project content can be kept, deleted or transferred after a preview, with shared-pearl protection and recovery records.
The public package starts with an empty library and includes Chinese and English interfaces, update history, acknowledgements and Discord feedback.
